findings.title: Reject symlink artifacts or scan their indexed link text
findings.trigger: An author stages a covered report as a symlink to a clean report at an absolute private path.
findings.execution_path: git ls-files includes the symlink. grep, hashing and cp follow its target and inspect the target's contents. The final git diff succeeds when the symlink itself matches the index, but Git commits the link text, not those target contents.
findings.consequence: The gate can report PASS while publishing an unscanned absolute home path or hostname in the symlink blob. This can result from ordinary use of links to reference scratch reports, without deliberate evasion.
findings.evidence: The file list contains no mode information or symlink rejection. All content checks dereference filesystem paths, while lines 94–99 assume worktree/index equality proves that the scanned bytes are the committed bytes. The self-test covers regular files only.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject symlink artifacts, preferably by checking index modes as well as filesystem type, or materialize and scan exact index blobs. Add a regression with a staged symlink whose clean target has a private absolute pathname.
findings.hypothesis: A staged symlink to a clean readable report will pass the current checks even when its indexed link text contains /Users/ or /home/. Filesystem reproduction was not run because the sandbox prohibits fixture creation.

findings.title: Update executor plans to use hash-bound hand-review entries
findings.trigger: An executor follows the plan to hand-review a harmless 32-character hexadecimal match.
findings.execution_path: The plan directs it to write '- `<path>`: not a credential -- <reason>', stage the files and invoke the gate. The gate requires ' sha256 `<current hash>`' between the path and disposition, so reviewed() rejects the prescribed entry.
findings.consequence: Following the instructions cannot clear a legitimate hand-review exception. Plans 04, 06, 07 and 10 repeat the incompatible format; plan 01 also embeds the older script and self-test as byte-for-byte implementation instructions.
findings.evidence: Executed the actual awk parser extracted from the committed gate: the plan-format entry returned 1, while the otherwise identical hash-bound entry returned 0. Existing self-tests intentionally reject hash-free entries but do not check agreement with executor instructions.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the plan examples and embedded implementation instructions to the current hash-bound contract, or replace duplicated script bodies with references to the committed scripts.
